title: Mega Mural Tour
blurb:
Go all in on Houston’s street art scene with our most immersive experience. The Mega Mural Tour is a 3-hour journey through Downtown, Midtown, Hardy Yards, and the Lower Heights, showcasing the murals that define Houston’s culture and creativity.
Houston is one of the most diverse cities in the world, and its walls reflect that. Experience artwork from local talent alongside internationally known artists from across the globe, each bringing different styles and cultural influences to the streets.
With extended time at each stop, you’ll see large-scale works, hidden gems, and fan favorites while having plenty of opportunities to capture photos and short videos along the way. Your guide keeps the experience smooth and engaging so you can enjoy every stop without feeling rushed.
Water is provided, and a bathroom stop is included for your comfort.
Tours are conducted by golf cart for a fun and easy ride. Accommodations can be made for guests with health-related needs.
